message: Hey friends! I just came across a super helpful resource about handling power outages, which got me thinking about those moments when the lights go out and the kids start asking a million questions. It’s all about staying calm and making it a fun family adventure instead! 🌟 I love the idea of having a little blackout kit ready so we can turn it into game night with flashlights — who doesn’t love a little indoor camping? What’s your favorite tip for keeping things light during an outage?
